1. Dividend income
2. Gains on disposal of
investments
3. Interest income
column3:
- Dividend income from investments is recognised when the
shareholders’ right to receive payment has been established.
Recognised based on point in time.
- Gains on disposal of investments are recognised when the Company
has no unfulfilled obligation that could affect the completion of the
transaction. Recognition based on point in time.
- Interest income is accrued using the effective interest rate method,
by reference to the principal outstanding and the interest rate
applicable. Interest income is recognised over time.

column2:
1. Sale of houses
2. Sale of land
3. Rental income
column3:
- Revenue from sale of housing units is recognised upon completion
and release of ownership to the respective buyers of the completed
units.Revenue is recognised at a point in time.
- Revenue from sale of land is recognised upon execution of the
transfer of title and settlement of the consideration of the land per
the agreement.Revenue is recognised at a point in time.
- Rental income is recognised on a straight line basis over the period
of the lease. Revenue is recognised at a point in time.

column2:
1. Change in fair value of
biological assets
2. Realised and unrealised
foreign exchange gains
column3:
- The change in fair value (less costs to sell) of a biological asset
between reporting dates is reported as a gain or loss. Recognition is
at a point in time.
- Foreign exchange gains and losses resulting from the settlement of
foreign currency transactions and from the translation at year-end
exchange rates of monetary assets and liabilities denominated in
foreign currencies are recognised in profit or loss. Recognition is at a
point in time.
